authority: One TV/server owns state, deadlines, random seed and scores. Phones send input only.
time: Server monotonic milliseconds; client timestamps are telemetry. Windows close on server receipt, never client clock.

inputEnvelope.sequence: strictly increasing per authenticated player/session; drop duplicate, old-phase and unknown-event inputs
inputEnvelope.payloadLimits: choice: listed option ID; move: x/y in [-1,1]; aim: x/y in [0,1]; tap/fire: no extra fields; byte limit 1024
inputEnvelope.rateLimit: 20 accepted movement/aim inputs per second and 8 taps/shots per second; excess dropped

disconnectPolicy: After 10 seconds without heartbeat, freeze movement and fill idle input with neutral actions. A disconnected player may reconnect for 30 seconds using the same identity; otherwise continue with deterministic bot or end a solo run as cancelled.
globalExit: Host Leave cancels to results from every nonterminal phase. Session cap 3600 seconds also cancels to results. Never keep a phone trapped in an unbounded phase.
randomness: Proposal: server-seeded generator, seed recorded with session. Content order, tie resolution and bot actions are replayable. Nintendo RNG distribution is not inferred.
scoreTies: Proposal: equal totals share winner status; competitive race finish events compare server tick, then share winners if the same tick.
phoneTvRoles: TV shows shared arena, timer, score and prompts; phones show only their controls, targets and choices. Touch buttons work without camera, microphone or motion permissions.
derivedEvents: Server derives all_ready from ready inputs; host choice Finish becomes host_finish or finish; host choice Retry becomes retry; leave becomes cancel. Objective/deadline/disconnect/terminal events are server-generated. Child results are immutable and surfaced by the parent selector.
